description: Propose regions to redact for a PERSON to accept in the Omitly desktop app (omitly#1643, bring your own AI). The explicit, preferred form for agents working alongside a lawyer: nothing is written by this call. The desktop app shows the proposal, the person accepts or rejects, and on acceptance Omitly removes the content, verifies nothing survives and seals the output with a record that a person decided. Requires the Omitly desktop app to be running on this computer; use get_proposal_status to follow the outcome. Same inputs as redact_pdf. Nothing is uploaded.

outputPath.description: your suggested path for the redacted PDF; the person picks the real one in Omitly's save dialog

pdfPath.description: absolute path to the source PDF

name: propose_redactions
